text: just seen a girl making matcha in her kitchen with a fork. no whisk. no bowl. no sieve. no blank street. just her and a mug of green lumps going grey in the sink. she drank it standing up. Absolute soldier
base_video: Creator sits at a kitchen counter holding their own iced drink, looking off camera and slowly raising the cup an inch like a toast, no smile.
caption: the fork is the part i can't get past
why_this_brand: The fork-whisked clumpy matcha in a mug is the exact home-matcha failure the brand's matcha drinkers are escaping.

text: i did three years of 9am lectures on bodega drip. no app. no rewards. no order ahead. no blank street. just me and a paper cup that tasted like a radiator. i genuinely thought that was what coffee was. Embarrassing for me specifically
base_video: Creator on a stoop or bus seat with a drink, staring into the middle distance, one slow blink and a small nod at the end.
caption: three years. no notes.
why_this_brand: Bodega drip on the walk to a 9am class is the specific student-in-the-city habit this brand replaces with app ordering and rewards.

text: watched two people on prince street argue about the seasonal flavor for eleven minutes. one holding the door. one holding two drinks. neither of them ordering ahead on the blank street app. cinnamon bun matcha going to whoever gets there first and it will not be them. Beautiful and stupid
base_video: Creator filming selfie-style on a busy sidewalk, glancing sideways at something off frame then back to camera with one eyebrow up.
caption: cinnamon bun or harvest chai. pick one.
why_this_brand: Prince Street, the door-holding two-drink friend meetup and the autumn cinnamon bun matcha are this brand's exact scene and menu.

text: my coworker has been drinking from the office nespresso machine since march. no walk. no queue. no blank street. no daylight. just him and a pod machine in a cupboard making the same drink forty times a day. he says he is saving money. he has not left the building. Concerning
base_video: Creator at a desk in an office or car, looking slowly left then right as if trying to find who is going to address this, then back to camera.
caption: someone go check on him
why_this_brand: The office pod machine versus the short walk out for a real coffee is the daily choice this brand's 9-to-5 crowd makes.

text: 8:40am on a manhattan sidewalk. a man in a full sprint holding a cup he queued twenty minutes for. no order ahead. no app. no blank street. just him texting five minutes away for the third time while the walk sign runs out. he will be nineteen minutes late. Choices were made
base_video: Creator standing at a crosswalk holding a paper cup, watching something pass, doing a slow double take back to the lens.
caption: the third five minutes away is a lie
why_this_brand: The 8:40am power-walk to the office with a paper cup and a fake ETA is the brand's core commuter moment.

text: my roommate makes iced matcha with a sachet and tap water. no ice. no milk. no shaker. no blank street. just powder, a glass and pure willpower. she posts it every single time. the photo is grey. she calls it a treat. Unwell in a very quiet way
base_video: Creator on the sofa holding their phone up as if being shown a photo, looks at it, looks at camera, holds the stare.
caption: grey matcha should be reportable
why_this_brand: Instant sachet matcha photographed for the internet is the exact failure state of the matcha-girl posting habit this brand serves.
